title: One density choice is shared by Tech View and Board View and kept
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Second device/browser and a second location available.
custom_steps:
1. Set Comfortable in List.
  2. Switch to Tech View and Board View and confirm Comfortable is applied.
  3. Log out/in, open on a second device, and change location; confirm the density persists.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • One density selection is shared between Tech View and Board View (List keeps today's row size).
  • The chosen density persists across sessions, logout/login and devices.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10049 — Density in Tech View and Board View. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S6-R3, S6-R7 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
